thread:
jules: FYI rolled 'compact-wave' micro-batcher into a 12-node canary at 09:40. short summary: p50 -9%, p95 -15%, p99 -19% on conversational traces; token cost down ~13% overall. :sparkles:

rahul: awesome. what is compact-wave doing differently?

jules: two quick bullets: 1) aggressive minibatch coalescing for short-response chat by preferring smaller, more homogeneous micro-batches; 2) kernel-alignment step to avoid mixed-quant path penalties. tiny config snippet below:
```
microbatcher:
  profile: compact-wave
  max_microbatch_ms: 40
  homogeneity_threshold: 0.85
kernel_align:
  enabled: true
  prefer_small_kernels: true
```

maya: did you run steady + spike traces? any regression on long-form?

jules: ran ci/evals/compact_wave_smoke + prod-extracts (steady/spike). long-form (>3k tokens) falls back to legacy microbatcher. no output-quality regressions in evals.

metrics-bot: run_id=run_20240618_0940_compact_01, throughput=+8%, kvcache_hit=+5% (short prefixes), link=https://perf/reports/run_20240618_0940_compact_01

rahul: multiplex/streaming tails?

jules: multiplex p99 improved ~11ms on average; streaming saw tighter p95. main improvement is avoiding huge heterogeneous packs that escalate kernel slow paths.

maya: interesting. any memory or GC issues?

jules: small transient allocation spike during warmup (tracked in perf/gc/1735009999) but <250ms. not impacting p99.

opsbot: deploy event: canary:eng-runtime/compact-wave-v1 -> nodes:12 -> status: success -> ts=1735009999

rahul: rollout plan?

jules: +40% capacity in 12h, full roll in 36h if no alerts. keeping canary-oncall pinned for 24h post-flip. added enterprise smoke to gating suite.

maya: please add a short blurb for the infra bulletin and tag @product for release notes.

jules: will draft and drop in #eng-release-notes after full flip. thanks team. :rocket:
